result.title: Esports World Model Dataset
result.summary: Interactive world models must capture how multiple participants jointly change a shared environment while observing different parts of it. Competitive games make this challenge concrete: players cooperate and compete, while fog of war, team vision and camera placement determine what each can see. Modeling these interactions requires data that connect individual observations and actions to shared state and events. We introduce the Esports World Model Dataset (EWM), a collection of human gameplay spanning StarCraft II, Dota 2 and Counter-Strike 2, with 3,053 games and maps and approximately 4,880 player-view hours, including estimated hours for the ongoing CS2 extension. It includes 4,628 completed StarCraft II views, all ten perspectives for 303 Dota 2 matches, and up to ten views per round in CS2. Across these views, replay-clock alignment connects rendered video with game-native actions, structured state and events from the same match. The three games expose complementary observation conditions: private fog of war, shared team vision and first-person viewpoints. In StarCraft II, player-specific entity records further distinguish live observations from remembered snapshots and link co-observed entities across opposing views. Together with temporal alignment, these records allow researchers to distinguish legitimate information differences from disagreement about shared state. By connecting human decisions, shared dynamics and player-specific information, EWM supports research toward jointly controlled multiplayer world models and interactive environments populated by teammates and opponents learned from human play.

AI.brief_summary: 发布 EWM 电子竞技世界模型数据集，覆盖 StarCraft II、Dota 2 与 CS2 共 3053 局、约 4880 玩家视角小时，用回放时钟把渲染视频、原生动作、结构化状态与事件对齐，并以玩家级实体记录区分实时观测与记忆快照。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「实时观测 vs 记忆快照」的记录与跨对立视角的实体关联，可能为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选、信念状态以及被遮蔽信息可用性的诊断提供数据与评测线索，是否迁移到 VLM 推理尚需核查。
